change.before: "instance selection by EBS maximum bandwidth could fail or select incorrectly when EbsOptimizedInfo was absent"
change.after: "instance selection by EBS maximum bandwidth properly checks for EbsOptimizedInfo existence"

consequence.statement: Environments that select instances by EBS maximum bandwidth will no longer encounter failures caused by missing EbsOptimizedInfo.
consequence.remediation: No action required; upgrade to v1.0.0 to receive the bug fix.

assertion.statement: Karpenter now ensures EbsOptimizedInfo exists when selecting instances by EBS maximum bandwidth, fixing a bug that could occur when this information was missing.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: exposure depends on whether the environment selects instances using EBS maximum bandwidth constraints at runtime, which is not statically visible in configuration
